task.title: Move between workspaces
task.shortdesc: Open another of your trees, and see which one is open now.

context.p: You can keep more than one tree. Each one is a workspace, and each has a card on . The card of the open tree is marked . The sample tree, Brontë family of Haworth, has a card too. Choose on it to go back to the family that the examples in this guide use. If you removed the sample tree, make the people of the examples yourself, as shows.

stepresult.p: The page says that each workspace is one family tree file, and that your changes are saved to the file as you go. Each tree has a card.

step.cmd: Find the card of the tree you want.

info.p: The card shows the name of the tree and how many persons, families and events it holds. It also shows , , and , which is a percentage.

stepresult.p: That tree is now the open one, and its card is marked .

result.p: Everything you see now is from the tree you chose.
Choose on a card to see the name of the file of that tree. The card also shows a line that starts uFTi and a version number. The button then reads .
